name: Musca Macedda
body:
Musca Macedda
CR 7

This giant fly has sharp mandibles that snap feverishly in your direction flanking its blood-sucking proboscis, while its multifaceted eyes glow with hunger and frenzy.

XP 3,200
N Large vermin
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +8 natural, -1 size)
hp 85 (10d8+40)
Fort +11, Ref +6, Will +6
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee bite +13 (2d6+10)
Space 10 ft., Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks rend (bite, 2d6+10)

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 17, Con 19, Int –, Wis 16, Cha 2
Base Atk +7; CMB +15; CMD 28 (34 vs. trip)
Skills Climb +15, Fly +9, Perception +7; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate or tropical
Organization solitary, pair, or swarm (3-12)
Treasure incidental

The musca macedda (“butcher fly”) has a taste for meat, be it dead or still alive. Only one exemplar of this giant vermin is able to strip off all the flesh from an ox in a matter of moments. Musche macedde are sometimes used by wizards as guardians for magic treasures hidden in dungeons or deep marshes.

This insectoid creature resembles a massive mosquito blended with other insects in a horrific hybrid. A furious buzzing rises from it as a hovering mass of black dots surrounds its rapidly fluttering wings like miniature bloodsucking companions. Its eyes are faceted but its mouth is crooked in a sinister smile below its long proboscis.
